title: Prospective study to evaluate the creation of generally understandable medical reports – ALOA-P
summary: Patients at Tübingen University Hospital receive a medical discharge letter after their hospitalization. These letters are primarily addressed to the physician providing further treatment, which is why they are written in medical jargon and contain numerous technical terms. As a result, the comprehensibility of these letters is restricted for patients. The University Hospital therefore aims to develop an automated process that uses artificial intelligence to convert medical discharge letters into generally understandable language. This letter is sent to patients after medical review and accompanying error logging. In addition to the letter, patients receive two questionnaires asking them to evaluate the comprehensibility of the doctor's letter and the generally understandable letter so that the two letters can be compared in this regard.

interventions.name: Evaluation of generally understandable letters generated with the help of artificial intelligence, on the one hand by medical professionals with regard to medical accuracy and on the other hand by patients with regard to comprehensibility

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Oncological surgery, Adequate knowledge of German
Exclusion criteria:
<18 years of age; insufficient knowledge of German to understand the study
